subject: Food Truck Permits
overview: The City Council held a brief special meeting to consider mayoral communications. The council approved food truck permits for the Circle the Square and West Medford Open Studios events.

items.title: Food truck permitting (23-328)
items.summary: Approved food truck permits for Chicken & Rice Guys, Frozen Hoagies, and Bon Me Foods LLC to operate at upcoming Circle the Square and West Medford Open Studios events.
